name: Rivenhal
description: A trading town of brick and tar on the fenland road, where keys are sold and nothing is given away.

gate.name: The East Gate
gate.description: A broad brick gate with a tar-black timber door, standing open. The town smells of rope and salt.

street.name: Tarry Street
street.description: A crooked street of brick shopfronts and tarred shutters, busy with carts. Doors open to every side.

arms.name: The Armourers' Row
arms.description: A wide shop with racks of every sort of arm, run by a man with a loud voice.

keys.name: The Locksmith's
keys.description: A small, bright shop of hooks and boards, hung with keys of brass in rows.

inn.name: The Sign of the Pilgrim
inn.description: A big, busy inn, always a little too warm. The landlord keeps a narrow door at the back that is always shut.

north.failure_message: The door at the back of the inn is locked. A brass key would answer it.

back_room.name: The Inn's Back Room
back_room.description: A cramped back room behind a locked door, holding a stack of crates and a second locked door.

north.failure_message: A second door, locked as well. Another key.

strongroom.name: The Strongroom
strongroom.description: A tiny, dry strongroom, locked twice over. A small chest stands on a stand.

elder.name: The Scholar's House
elder.description: A house crowded with maps and pots of ink. An elderly scholar peers over a half-finished chart.
